verdicts.reason:
The mechanism is real, but the impact is overstated, and the submitted rollout is not affected.

CONFIRMED
1. The simulator uses the URDF centre of mass.
   - flash_chord scene/objects.py imports objects with add_urdf(..., ignore_inertial_definitions=False).
   - Newton 1.2.0 import_urdf.py (L639-666) overwrites body_com and body_mass from the URDF inertial block.
   - The CoACD hulls are added with density=0.0, so they add no mass.
   - So the sim COM is the mesh origin. The bob1 pot URDF has inertial xyz 0 0 0, mass 0.3 kg, inertia 1e-3 diag, and its collision STL has the same frame/bbox as the OBJ.
2. Geometry numbers match.
   - Origin to area-weighted shell centroid: 8.04 cm. Origin to volume centroid: 5.89 cm.
   - Footprint margin with the pot sitting flat on its base (STL / closest cached CoACD set): origin -3.35 / -3.28 cm (outside); shell centroid +4.67 / +4.70 cm; volume centroid +2.53 / +2.57 cm.
3. A no-hands MuJoCo settle on the bob1 support (pot alone, and pot plus spoon, dt 0.002 and 1/101.27) shows the pot falls over on its own.
   - COM at origin, from the f0 pose: tilt 10-11 deg at 0.1 s and 23.2-23.6 deg at 0.25 s (about 5 control frames at 20.25 fps). It rests at 23.0 deg on the handle, with ADD 4.45 cm vs the f0 pose.
   - From the f289 and f312 poses it also ends at 23.0 deg (ADD 5.0-5.1 cm).
   - COM at the shell centroid: 0.3 deg from upright at all three poses.
   - COM at the volume centroid: holds at f0, but at f289 it swings 12 deg before recovering. The shell centroid is the safer choice.
4. Census, recomputed from the parquets (tilt relative to the reference):
   - Submitted s42 (md5 b396539a): never above 10 deg; max 1.2 deg in f0-50; final 1.3 deg.
   - 3/28 rollouts end upright and 25/28 end tipped, as claimed.
   - End-of-episode absolute tilt is 22.5-24.3 deg. The 26-29 deg in the census is measured against a reference that is itself tilted 4.4 deg (A1) or 6.8 deg (A2/B1) at f312.

OVERSTATED
a. "12.6 cm outside at f312" is an artifact. The f312 reference pot is tilted 4.4 deg and dips 0.53 cm into the support, so only a 10x4.8 cm sliver of the base was counted as footprint. With the pot flat, the margin is -3.3 cm, the same as at f0.
b. "12/28 tip at rest" includes 4 w_*seat runs that already show a 14.2 deg error in the first recorded frame and peak at 68-98 deg. That is a reset/seating ejection, not quiet tipping. Quiet tips at rest are 7/28 before f36 (A1 s44 f8, A2C s43 f7, w_ctl s43 f3, w_fix s43 f16, w_fix s44 f35, c_b1 s42 f34, c_b1 s43 f16), or 8/28 counting A2C s42 at f48.
c. ygrip s43 counts as upright only because the pot was never lifted (9 of 171 lift frames).
d. Loss per seed. I replaced the pot ADD in the tipped frames with s42's ADD in the same frames.
   - Losses: A1 s43 0.026, s44 0.025, A1seat s42 0.004, A1seat s43 0.039, c s42 0.043, c s43 0.091.
   - Average over the 7 bob1-mesh rollouts (including s42 = 0): 0.033 per retrain.
   - The finding's 0.30 for c s43 blames its never-lifted pot on the tip. That is unproven: 7 runs never lifted the pot with tilt of 2.5 deg or less in f0-50.
e. The ep5 +0.054 is not COM evidence. The COM-only arm (o_ep5_com_s42/s43 on orchard) reached own-ref 0.31/0.33 (checkpoints 0.22-0.39). Attach+COM reached 0.83-0.89, and the control wv2_ep5_ctl_s43 was 0.25. The gain came mostly from the hand re-attach.
f. The hull set that best matches the bob1 pot in the shared cache is 3.2 mm off in bbox. The exact sim hulls were not found, so the MuJoCo result is indicative.

verdicts.reason:
The measurements are right, but the main interpretation is backwards: the objects are not floating, the support is too low.

What checks out:
- Gaps above support_0 at f0: pot +1.22 cm, spoon +1.95 cm. support_0 is a cylinder, r 0.298 m, top 0.98781.
- The rollout drops 14.35 mm with 0 deg rotation on both bodies at step 0. At rest it sits below support_0: pot -0.37 (P0) / -0.38 (P4), spoon -0.48 / -0.62 cm.
- AUC.py anchors on slot 0 (white_pot) at f0, so every rollout pose is shifted exactly +1.435 cm in z (0 deg).
- The seat build is defective. The spoon disk (centre 0.217/0.061, r 0.184, top 1.0053) reaches under the pot (bottom 1.0000). It shoved the rollout pot 3.4 cm and 2.1 deg at f0 in s42, and 2.2 cm and 1.4 deg in s43.

What is wrong or overstated:
1. The video depth puts the table about 1.9 cm above support_0, and the objects sit on it. My own RANSAC table fit from the FoundationStereo depth at f0-30 (inlier fraction 0.76-0.99, rms 0.8-1.9 mm): the table is +1.5..+1.9 cm above support_0 at the start spots and tilted 2.2-3.5 deg. The spoon bottom sits on it (-0.06..+0.37 cm). The pot's lowest vertex is -0.3..-0.7 cm, which is what an 18 cm flat bottom shows on a 2.4 deg tilt. Mesh vs depth inside the masks agrees to within 0.3 cm. The existing depth run (~/v2d_ops/kenc/depthtab/ep3/out/run.log) agrees: table minus support +1.87 cm (pot) and +1.96 cm (spoon); spoon -0.01 cm. So support_0 is about 1.9 cm too low.
2. The "1.07 cm start/end inconsistency" does not leave the true rest height open. The start rest is right; the pot's END pose is wrong. At f295-312 its lowest vertex is 1.0-2.6 cm below the depth table, and it is tilted 4.4 deg from its f0 up axis. Its centroid drops only 0.48 cm (f288) and 0.85 cm (f312). The support_0 top (0.98781) matches this sunk end pose (f288 bottom 0.9881).
3. "Spoon floats at both rests, so its carry is biased up 1.5-2 cm" is wrong. Under the AUC.py alignment the spoon carry ADD rises only from 1.92 to 2.11 cm.
4. Net effect of the anchor shift. I ran the AUC.py procedure with our own reference as pseudo-GT:
   - Submitted s42: 0.9146 aligned vs 0.9146 unaligned, so 0.000. The pot loses 0.031 (P2 ADD 1.44 vs 0.61 cm). The spoon gains 0.030 (P0 2.32→0.89, P3 2.32→1.29, P4 2.31→1.08 cm).
   - s43: -0.015. s44: -0.024.
   The +1.4 cm carry error is real, but it trades against the rest-phase gap.
5. Fix option 2 (lower the rest poses onto support_0) would move the reference about 1.9 cm below the real table, so it must not be used. Option 3 (fit the table from depth) has effectively been done and settles it: raise the support. Option 1 (disks) points the right way but was built defectively.

Counterfactual, with the support at the reference rest height (rest z = reference - 0.5 cm sink): proxy gain +0.025..+0.028 (s42), +0.019..+0.022 (s43), +0.026..+0.029 (s44). The two seat runs (proxy 0.898 / 0.892) are no clean test. The seed spread (A1 own-ref 0.80-0.91) is far larger than the effect.

Cause: support_0 is about 1.9 cm below the real table. The FoundationStereo depth table is +1.5..+1.9 cm above support_0 at the start spots and +2.1..+2.5 cm at the end spots, tilted about 2.4 deg. Neither object floats.

- The pot's end rest f259-312 is wrong: 1.0-2.6 cm below the table and tilted 4.4 deg from its f0 up axis.

Kaggle (AUC.py, pot anchor): lifted poses sit +1.435 cm high relative to the reference. Pot carry ADD is 1.44 vs 0.61 cm; spoon 2.11 vs 1.92 cm (not +1.5-2 cm). Rest-phase errors shrink by the same shift. The net cost is 0.000 on the submitted s42 and -0.013 mean over seeds s42-44.

Fix: raise the single support_0 by rule. Use the depth-table plane, clipped to the lowest f0 resting bottom (here about 0.998-1.000, the pot). Never place it above that, or the pot is pushed up at step 0 and the anchor shifts the other way. Then re-seat the pot's end-rest pose on the same plane with its f0 up axis. Do NOT lower the rest poses (fix 2). Do not use per-object disks that reach under a neighbour.

Expected gain: about +0.02 episode AUC (proxy +0.019..+0.029 per seed against our own reference). It is untested (the only seat runs are defective builds) and well inside seed noise.

plan_fixes.name: F2: put the support plane at the anchor pot's frame-0 rest bottom and lift any frame that sinks below it (Scene P = k8_ep3_P)
plan_fixes.targets: ep3-B2-seating-gap-anchor-shift. Also ep3_pot_rest_float_zdrift, which is superseded: support_0 is too low; the objects do not float. Also the pickup-gap part of ep3_spoon_object_levelling.
plan_fixes.fix_type: support and seating rule applied inside the scene build (H5_PATCH), then a rebuild with the A1 recipe
plan_fixes.automatic_rule:
Applied after levelling and before the hands are attached.
1) Plane z_p = the lowest posed-mesh vertex among the objects resting at frame 0. Here that is the slot-0 anchor pot. The plane is never above any resting object's frame-0 bottom, and it must lie within 1.5 cm of the video-depth table.
2) On every frame where an object's lowest vertex is below z_p, lift that object by the deficit. Smooth the lift as dz = mean over 5 frames of (max over 11 frames of the deficit), so no frame stays below and nothing jumps.
3) On those frames, shift any hand whose wrist is within 10 cm of the lifted object by the same dz.
4) Never lower anything.
5) The support detector then builds the support at z_p. Fallback: translate support_0 so its top equals z_p.
